verdictBasis: Fourteen of the fifteen obligations measure PASS on the current bytes, all nine counters are zero on my own read-only run, and both fixtures re-hash to the digests the owner pinned. One obligation fails on appearance. Five of the eight delivered pages - the sworn petition (page 2), the proposed order (page 4), the certificate of service (page 5), the exhibit checklist (page 6) and the filing instructions (page 8) - print an internal machine route key, and it is hard-split mid-token so the page reads '...conviction-expungemen' then 't-99-19-71-1'. On page 4 that broken identifier sits directly beneath the judicial-officer signature line and the prosecuting authority's approval-as-to-form block of an order the court is asked to sign. A defect visible on a delivered page fails CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP even when the counters are green, and a hard-split token is named in that class. Nothing else about this family is wrong: the legal substance, the refusals, the protected blanks and the honesty about the s 99-19-72 fee question are the strongest in the set I read today.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: One route key, obligation:track-pathway:MS:ms-misd-1st:first-offender-nontraffic-misdemeanor-conviction-expungement-99-19-71-1, identical in the source receipt, the field map and product-wiring, and still carried by the census. The packet is built for s 99-19-71(1), the first-offender nontraffic misdemeanour conviction route, and its own pages say so - including the point that the offence must not be a traffic violation and must not be a DUI, which has a separate route.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: A hard-split internal route key printed on five of the eight delivered pages. Pages 2, 4, 5, 6 and 8 each end with a block reading 'Route:' then 'obligation:track-pathway:MS:ms-misd-1st:first-offender-nontraffic-misdemeanor-conviction-expungemen' then 't-99-19-71-1' - the identifier is broken mid-token across the line break, with no hyphen, so the printed page shows the fragment 'expungemen'. Page 2 is the sworn petition, page 4 the proposed order the court is asked to sign, page 5 the certificate of service. On page 4 the broken identifier sits immediately below the JUDICIAL OFFICER OF THE COURT signature line and the prosecuting authority's approval-as-to-form block. I confirmed it by rendering page 4 at 110 dpi and reading the image, not only from the text layer. Everything else in this class is clean: 0 words fall outside the MediaBox on any of the 16 pages across both fixtures, there is no text render mode 3 or 7, no zero-size font, no white-on-white write, no orphaned signature page, no route-key-only or fragment page, no source-shipped ink (there is no source binary), no catch-all field match and no clipped or overrun value; my overlapping-word scan returned zero pairs on both fixtures.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: 'File the petition, with the proposed order and the certificate of service, with the court in which the conviction was had' - and the packet leads with the reason that is hard: Mississippi has four trial court levels that all handle expungements and people routinely misidentify which one heard their case, so step one is to have the records office confirm it. The caption prints the instruction to write the court and its county, or for a municipal court its city, rather than guessing one.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Answered with its uncertainty stated rather than papered over: no amount is published, because s 99-19-72 levies a fee on petitions to expunge under s 99-19-71 but 'its reach and its collection in lower courts are recorded open questions'. The participant is told to confirm the amount and any pauper's-affidavit route with the court's records office before filing, and the same open question is repeated in the 'What this packet does not tell you' section.

SERVICE.finding: Deliver a copy of the petition and the proposed order to the prosecuting authority - for a circuit court case the district attorney for the circuit district, for a county, justice or municipal court case the county or municipal prosecuting attorney, and for a municipal court case the city prosecutor rather than the district attorney - by United States mail or hand delivery, with the certificate of service completed only when the copy actually goes out. No prosecutor name or address is invented.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: A named six-condition stop list on the delivered page: uncertain first-offender status or any prior conviction anywhere, any prior expunged case, an offence that may be a traffic violation, a DUI, a municipal-court conviction alongside justice-court convictions, and non-citizenship. The exhibit checklist adds its own refusal - do not attach an indictment on this track unless the case was actually indicted, because pleading one that does not exist would be false.
